text: The first AI governance platform from India.
AI is already everywhere in your business.
And the faster it moves, the harder it is to see.
Niticore brings all of it into one clear view.
Discover every model, agent and dataset, even the ones hiding in the shadows.
Assess the risk of each one, the moment it appears.
Align with the EU AI Act and ISO 42001, and keep your evidence audit-ready, always.
Set guardrails for every agent, with people in the loop when it matters most.
And watch over everything, continuously, as it happens.
So you can innovate with confidence, and prove it.
